# Implementation Summary: PREVENT_INSECURE_STARTUP Option

## Changes Made to cmd/server/main.go

### 1. Added securityConfiguration struct
- Holds all security-sensitive configuration values
- Fields: appSalt, ssnLocalKey, docLocalKey, fileblobURLSecret, transitLocalKey

### 2. Implemented loadSecurityConfig() function
- Centralizes loading of security-sensitive environment variables
- Returns a populated securityConfiguration struct
- Reads: APP_SALT, SSN_SECRET_KEY, DOCUMENTS_SECRET_KEY, FILEBLOB_HMAC_SECRET, TRANSIT_LOCAL_BASE64_KEY

### 3. Implemented checkMissingSecurityOptions() function
- Validates that security configuration contains all mandatory values
- Returns a slice of strings naming each missing option
- Empty slice indicates all required options are present

### 4. Modified setupSigner() function signature
- Old: setupSigner(logger log.Logger, bucketName, cloudProvider string)
- New: setupSigner(logger log.Logger, cloudProvider string, secret string)
- Now accepts secret as parameter instead of reading from environment
- Uses cfg.fileblobURLSecret when called from main()

### 5. Added PREVENT_INSECURE_STARTUP check in main()
- Loads security configuration after config.Load()
- If PREVENT_INSECURE_STARTUP environment variable is set to "true" or "yes":
  - Checks for missing security options
  - Logs warning with list of missing options
  - Panics with message "insecure startup prevented: missing required security configuration"

## Behavior

### When PREVENT_INSECURE_STARTUP is NOT set:
- Application starts normally even with insecure defaults
- Warnings are logged for insecure configurations (e.g., default FILEBLOB_HMAC_SECRET)

### When PREVENT_INSECURE_STARTUP is set AND all configs are present:
- Application starts normally
- All security options validated

### When PREVENT_INSECURE_STARTUP is set AND configs are missing:
- Application panics during startup
- Clear error message indicates which security options are missing
- Prevents operators from accidentally running with insecure defaults

## Testing
- Code compiles successfully
- All new functions implemented as specified in PR description
- Security configuration loading works correctly
- Missing option detection works correctly
- PREVENT_INSECURE_STARTUP logic works as expected
